name: multi-turn
what: Multi-turn editing: "it", "the first one", "the vignette one" resolve to the right asset

steps.text: Now add a soft vignette to it.
Upscale the first one you made, not the vignette.
Put the word 'NAVY' at the bottom of the vignette one.

turns.agent: I'll use an image edit to make your jet photo black and white while keeping everything else unchanged.

turns.text: Now add a soft vignette to it.
turns.agent: I'll add a soft vignette to the black-and-white jet picture with one image edit, keeping everything else unchanged.

turns.text: Upscale the first one you made, not the vignette.
turns.agent: I'll upscale the black-and-white jet picture with the image upscaler, keeping its appearance and composition unchanged.

turns.text: Put the word 'NAVY' at the bottom of the vignette one.
turns.agent: I'll add “NAVY” at the bottom with a text overlay and leave the rest of the picture unchanged.
I'll use the crop tool to make the existing picture square, keeping the crop centered without regenerating anything.
